pr_title: [api-minor] Set font size and color for text widget annotations
pr_body:
The display layer for annotation did not consider the font size in input fields.

I added the parsing and assigning of the font size of the input field. Aside from my own issues of PDFs not beeing correctly rendered on Screen, this fixes the too large rendered text fields in issue #7367 as well as the too small rendered text field in issue #11199 .

I did not change any rendering steps, as the font size seems to be considered there. One remaining issue are fields with font size "auto" which corresponds to size 0.

Fixes #7367.
Fixes #11199.
pr_comments: If #12831 gets merged, i would rewrite my changes to use the defaultAppearance parser and font-size calculations for auto-size provided in that PR

I've rewritten my old commit and now use the parsed default appearance data which was introduced by @calixteman in #12831 .
As this is my first PR, maybe someone can guide me how to go on from now? Just wait till someone is going to review this PR or is there anything to do now?
Please also follow https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/wiki/Squashing-Commits
Looks good to me once the merge conflict is resolved (happened because we just merged #12886 that also touched the same code, but simplified it). We'll run a preview and the tests after this is done.

issue_context.title: Form Field doesn't have the correct font size
issue_context.body: Attach (recommended) or Link to PDF file here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1UjLxnFw2g3gn3tvNLRYLdmG6mFdFKCcr Configuration: - Web browser and its version: Chrome 77.0.3865.90 - Operating system and its version: Mac mojave 10.14.6 - PDF.js version: 2.3.194 - Is a browser extension: Nope Steps to reproduce the problem: 1. Make sure to set `renderInteractiveForms` to `true` 2. The read-only form field(Sample title) doesn't honor it's proper font-size What is the expected behavior? What went wrong?
comments: Most likely this is a duplicate of #7367, but I'm not entirely sure.

> Most likely this is a duplicate of #7367, but I'm not entirely sure.

Not entirely sure either since based from my observation and the PDFs I've used, text fields has a default smaller font sizes regardless of it's true font-size.

review_comments:
This PR should have a reference test attached to it so we can avoid future regressions. One of the PDF files from the issues you mentioned will suffice, or another file you may have that is smaller and shows the same issue that this PR fixes. Since this shows up when rendering forms, you can add a test similar to https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/commit/adf0972ca57e66202acb489b8782a3b73d510bf5#diff-bbeef90df04bff7617f7ef59e3f37cac92192c5169bc500d857bd6fb107fcabd: add the PDF file, add a gitignore entry and add a manifest entry with `"forms": true` to enable form rendering for your reference test. This should look something like this (see the link above for how we did it there):

```
    {  "id": "issue7367",
       "file": "pdfs/issue7367.pdf",
       "md5": "<insert md5 hash of the file>",
       "rounds": 1,
       "type": "eq",
       "forms": true
    },
```
